name: TC LMS SG - Tertiary Courses
subtitle: Classes, attendance & alerts
promotionalText: Your Tertiary Courses Singapore classes in your pocket, for learners and trainers: class reminders, attendance, materials, feedback and certificates.
description:
TC LMS SG is the app for learners and trainers of Tertiary Courses Singapore (www.tertiarycourses.com.sg). Sign in with your website email and everything about your classes is in one place.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
• Get a one-time code by email, or use your website password.

MY CLASSES
• See your current, upcoming and past classes with dates, times, venue or online class link.
• Trainers see the classes they teach beside the classes they attend, each clearly labelled.
• Join live online classes in one tap.

CLASS REMINDERS
• Get a reminder 3 days before a class starts, the evening before each class day, and an hour before it begins. Turn them off any time in Account.

DIGITAL ATTENDANCE
• Learners check in to the current session from their phone.
• Trainers take attendance for each session, and show a check-in QR code for learners to scan.

CLASS MATERIALS
• Open slides, learner guide, lesson plan, labs and certificates inside the app, with Share and Open in Safari.

COURSE FEEDBACK
• Learners complete the in-house course feedback survey right in the app; trainers see how many have responded.

CALENDAR
• A month view of your class days, and "Add My Classes to Calendar" for your iPhone calendar.

CERTIFICATES AND BILLING
• View and share your certificates. See your course registrations, payment status and invoice numbers.

PROFILE AND APPEARANCE
• Edit your name and phone number, and choose Light, Dark or System appearance. Your choice is saved to your account.

BROWSE COURSES
• Explore our short courses, see durations and fees, and enquire on WhatsApp.

A learner account is created when you register for a course on www.tertiarycourses.com.sg; trainers sign in with their trainer login. You can delete your account at any time from Account → Delete Account.

review.notes:
TC LMS SG is the learner and trainer app for Tertiary Courses Singapore's learning management system (www.tertiarycourses.com.sg). Accounts are created by registering for a course on the website; the app has no sign-up.

SIGN IN: on the Sign In tab choose "Password" and use the demo account above. It is a dedicated App Review sample account: it shows sample classes (one in progress today, one upcoming, two past) with sample billing and certificate, and nothing it does is saved to real learner records.

TO TRY EVERYTHING:
• My Classes → tap the "In progress" class → "Check In Now" (digital attendance), open "Course Outline" (class materials), "Give Feedback" (in-house survey).
• Calendar → class days are highlighted; "Add My Classes to Calendar" asks for write-only calendar access.
• Certificates → "View PDF" opens the sample certificate.
• Billing → registrations and payment status.
• Courses (signed out) → public course catalog.
• Account → Delete Account permanently deletes a real learner's login account (for the shared sample account it only signs out, so later reviews can still sign in).

NEW IN 1.4:
• Trainer view: the sample account is also a sample trainer. In My Classes the class tagged "Teaching" opens the trainer screen: Take Attendance (toggle learners, Save Attendance) and Show Check-in QR.
• Class reminders are LOCAL notifications scheduled on the device from the class list (no push service). The app asks for notification permission after the classes first load; Account → Class reminders turns them off.
• Account → profile row → Edit Profile: name, phone and Appearance (System / Light / Dark).
• Materials and certificates open in an in-app viewer with Share and Open in Safari.

whatsNew:
• Trainers can now sign in: see the classes you teach, take attendance and show a check-in QR code.
• Class reminders before every class, for learners and trainers.
• Class materials and certificates open inside the app.
• Edit your profile, and choose Light, Dark or System appearance.
• Classes refresh automatically when you return to the app.
